title: An inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient method for constrained convex finite-sum optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.23221v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study a class of constrained convex finite-sum optimization problems. In many practical applications, all or some of the constraints are hard constraints that represent imperative requirements. Consequently, any desirable approximate solution must (nearly) satisfy these constraints. Motivated by this, we focus on computing an $\epsilon$-$surely\ feasible\ stochastic\ optimal$ ($\epsilon$-SFSO) solution, in which the constraint violation is deterministically bounded by $\epsilon$, and the expected optimality gap is at most $\epsilon$. While a recently proposed stochastic variance-reduced first-order penalty method can compute an $\epsilon$-SFSO solution, there remains a significant gap between its first-order oracle complexity for computing an $\epsilon$-SFSO solution and that for computing an $\epsilon$-$expected\ feasible\ stochastic\ optimal$ solution, where both the expected constraint violation and the expected op

translated_title: 一种用于约束凸有限和优化的非精确随机方差缩减梯度方法
translated_abstract: 在这篇论文中，我们研究了一类约束凸有限和优化问题。在许多实际应用中，全部或部分约束是表示强制性要求的硬约束。因此，任何理想的近似解都必须（近似地）满足这些约束。受此启发，我们专注于计算一个ε-确定可行随机最优（ε-SFSO）解，其中约束违反被确定性地控制在ε以内，且期望最优性间隙至多为ε。虽然最近提出的一种随机方差缩减一阶惩罚方法可以计算ε-SFSO解，但其计算ε-SFSO解的一阶预言机复杂度与计算ε-期望可行随机最优解（其中期望约束违反和期望最优性间隙均至多为ε）的一阶预言机复杂度之间仍存在显著差距。
tldr: 该论文针对带硬约束的凸有限和优化问题，提出了一种非精确随机方差缩减梯度方法来计算ε-确定可行随机最优解，从而缩小了确定可行解与期望可行解之间的一阶预言机复杂度差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient method for computing ε-surely feasible stochastic optimal solutions to constrained convex finite-sum optimization problems with hard constraints, narrowing the first-order oracle complexity gap between surely feasible and expected feasible solutions.
